reason: I'm only commuting two days a week and I already have my spot where they know my order and get me out in two minutes. A new place with $8.50 dessert lattes and no reviews isn't enough to break that routine on a rushed morning.
objection: No reviews yet, so I have no idea if it's fast or actually good, and I'm not gambling my one morning coffee on a cherry pie matcha.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or a bunch of solid reviews saying the plain matcha is genuinely great and the line moves fast; then I'd grab the free sip and maybe switch on commute days.
